component.name: WorkerTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "work" m.inTask = false m.seen = [] end sub
sub onValue(event as object) if m.inTask then m.seen.push(event.getData().toStr()) end sub
sub work() m.inTask = true if m.top.runNo = 1 ' Busy in sleep() (no wait, no field access), so the write of 1 is never consumed here. m.top.ready = true sleep(1000) return end if start = m.top.value m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") for i = 1 to 10 wait(100, m.port) end for m.top.report = "run 2: value at start=" + start.toStr() + " onChange=[" + m.seen.join(",") + "] value at end=" + m.top.value.toStr() end sub
